description: This file defines the final class 'MetricsBuilder' in the Aws namespace, which is responsible for constructing and managing metrics data for AWS SDK requests. It includes constants for metric types, methods for appending and encoding metrics, and static helper functions. The class is internal and mainly used to gather performance or usage metrics during AWS SDK operations.

classes.name: MetricsBuilder
classes.description: A class for accumulating and encoding metrics related to AWS SDK requests, including signature type, compression, checksum, and credentials source.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the metrics string representation from accumulated metrics.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the metrics array into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a new metric if it fits size constraints and isn't already present.

methods.name: identifyMetricByValueAndAppend
methods.description: Identifies a metric by feature group and value, then appends it.

methods.name: appendSignatureMetric
methods.description: Appends signature-related metrics based on the signature value.

methods.name: appendRequestCompressionMetric
methods.description: Appends compression metrics based on format.

methods.name: appendRequestChecksumMetric
methods.description: Appends checksum metrics based on algorithm.

methods.name: appendCredentialsMetric
methods.description: Appends credential source metrics based on credentials object.

methods.name: canMetricBeAppended
methods.description: Checks if a new metric can be appended considering size and duplication.

methods.name: fromCommand
methods.description: Retrieves a MetricsBuilder instance from a command.

methods.name: appendMetricsCaptureMiddleware
methods.description: Appends a middleware to capture metrics during request handling.
